levels.surface: محمّد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطّاب

notes: The opening clause «و ما كان فيه عن أبي كهمس» is a scope remark, not the chain; the chain begins at «فقد رويته عن أبي». The bare «أبي» has no name: relation (rule 7), occurrence 2. The final name also occurs in the opening clause, so the longer surface is written. Blessing in dashes left out.
